name: a non-NANP destination with a flow that also lacks an opt-out
description: The resolver refuses a UK number: no line type, no timezone, so P1 is inconclusive. The flow also identifies and never offers opt-out, so P3 is false at the end. A false verdict blocks even when another property is held: block beats hold.

resolver.unsupported: not a North American number; number facts cover NANP destinations only
resolver.hoursBasis: no timezone: not a NANP number

call.why: 020 7946 0000 to 0999 is the range the UK regulator reserves for drama, and the numfacts tests already use this exact number.
